items.description:

items.headline: Flood Watch issued September 24 at 1:57PM AKDT until September 26 at 1:00PM AKDT by NWS Anchorage AK
items.description:

items.headline: Special Weather Statement issued September 24 at 10:39AM AKDT by NWS Anchorage AK
items.description:
A gale force front enters the western Gulf this afternoon and
quickly begins to move across Kodiak Island later this evening.
Accompanying the front will be an axis of moderate rainfall,
adding up to around one inch of rainfall for Kodiak City, with
areas such as Old Harbor seeing up to 2 inches of rainfall.
Southeast winds are expected to gust as high as 55 mph during the
frontal passage. The front clears the area and moves northeastward
by midday Friday.

-AM

items.headline: Wind Advisory issued September 24 at 6:58AM AKDT until September 27 at 4:00AM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Southeast winds 30 to 40 mph with gusts up to 60 mph
expected.

* WHERE...Windy Pass.

* WHEN...From midnight tonight to 4 AM AKDT Sunday.

* IMPACTS...Strong winds could blow around unsecured objects. Travel
could be difficult, especially for high profile vehicles.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Winds may decrease slightly Saturday afternoon
and evening before increasing briefly overnight into early Sunday.
items.instruction:
Winds this strong can make driving difficult, especially for high
profile vehicles. Use extra caution.
